title: CCM.M-K8.2024: Key comparison of kilogram realizations
version: Final report dated 8 December 2025, published in 2026 as CIPM MRA Comparison Reports 07001, BIPM PDF version 5.0, DOI 10.59161/QOFV3225

passages.note: The report records NIST-4 directly determining the mass of K85 and K104 in vacuum in January and February 2025, and supplies separately measured BIPM reference values and NIST results.
